hints.INTRO_SPELL: Introduce yourself using the keywords on the card (name, age, country, residence, languages, job, hobby).
hints.SPELL_WORD: Spell the word the examiner asks for (buchstabieren).
hints.READ_NUMBER: Read out the number/phone/postcode the examiner asks for.
hints.INTRO_CARD: Introduce yourself using the keywords on the card — speak in full sentences.
hints.ASK_PERSON: Ask your partner ONE question about the keyword on the card (e.g. Geburtstag? → Wann hast du Geburtstag?).
hints.ASK_QWORD: Ask ONE question about the topic, starting with the question word on the card.
hints.ASK_REQUEST: Look at the picture and make a request (Bitte) to your partner.
hints.ASK_CARD: Ask your partner ONE question about the word on the card.
hints.REACT_REQUEST: React to your partner's request (accept or decline politely).
hints.ANSWER_PARTNER: Answer the question your partner just asked (their card is shown here).
hints.PRESENT_LONG: Present your topic (introduction – content – conclusion). Speak fluently for 3–4 minutes; use your notes if needed.
hints.PRESENT_SHORT: Present/narrate your topic. Speak fluently with an introduction, content and a conclusion.
hints.ANSWER_PARTNER_PRESENTATION: Answer your partner's question about your presentation.
hints.ANSWER_QUESTION: Answer the question you were just asked.
hints.CONTACT_THEN_PRUEFER: Respond to your partner; then the examiner will ask one more question.
hints.OPEN_CALENDAR: Start: suggest a free day/time from YOUR calendar (your partner's calendar is different).
hints.OPEN_VORLAGE: Tell your partner what YOUR text (Vorlage) says (topic, key figures).
hints.OPEN_CONTACT: Start: greet, introduce yourself and ask your partner about a topic on the card.
hints.OPEN_DEBATE: Start: state your position on the question clearly with one main reason.
hints.OPEN_DEFAULT: Start: make the first suggestion / state your view.
hints.CLOSE_CALENDAR: Wrap up: repeat the date and time you agreed on.
hints.CLOSE_DEBATE: Conclude: summarise both sides, then say clearly whether you are for or against.
hints.CLOSE_DEFAULT: Conclude: summarise what you both agreed on.
hints.REACT_CALENDAR: Respond: agree if you are free; otherwise decline with a reason and suggest another time.
hints.REACT_VORLAGE: Respond to your partner's text; talk about your own experience/opinion and ask back.
hints.REACT_CONTACT: Answer, then ask your partner about another topic on the card.
hints.REACT_DEBATE: Counter the argument you just heard (concede a point, then argue the other way).
hints.REACT_DEFAULT: Respond to your partner: agree/disagree with a reason, then suggest the next point.
hints.FEEDBACK_COMMENT: Give your partner one comment on the presentation (what was good/new/interesting) and ask ONE question.
hints.ANSWER_PRUEFER_TOPIC: Answer the examiner's question about the topic.

tips.LESEN: Read short German texts every day and focus on everyday-life vocabulary.
tips.HOEREN: Listen to Deutsch A1 podcasts and everyday conversations to get used to German intonation.
tips.SCHREIBEN: Practise writing short emails in the Goethe format: introduction, questions, closing. Mind your grammar and sentence structure.
tips.SPRECHEN: Practise introducing yourself and simple conversations. Use the AI interview feature to get feedback on your pronunciation.
